description: Sets one note in any temperament from 1 to 34 notes per octave, and breaks an incoming pitch into an octave number and a note number for a pair of voltmeters

params.text: Sets the note within the octave of the pitch output, from 0 up to one less than the notes-per-octave setting
Sets the octave of the pitch output, -5 to +5
Sets the temperament, 1 to 34 notes in the octave, starting at 12
Rounds the note output to whole numbers, so a voltmeter reads 3 rather than 2.999; it is off at power-up and switches off whenever the temperament is changed

inputs.text: The pitch to be broken into an octave number and a note number, polyphonic; with nothing patched here the module reads its own V/Oct output instead

outputs.text: Carries the pitch set by the octave and note knobs, at a volt per octave, on one channel
The octave number of the incoming pitch, as that many volts, polyphonic
The note number within the octave of the incoming pitch, as that many volts, polyphonic
